description: The compute @group(0) layout (bindings 0–13) shared by every catalog shader. Single source for the TS layout (src/renderer/webgpu/pipeline.ts createComputeBindGroupLayout imports this JSON) and the C++ one (wasm_renderer/bind_group0.h, generated by scripts/gen-bind-group0-header.js). `npm run verify:device-policy` fails when the header is stale or either side stops reading the contract. Human-readable table: docs/BINDING_CONTRACT.md.

sampleTypes.color-format: rgba16float is always filterable → 'float'; rgba32float is 'float' only with the float32-filterable device feature, else 'unfilterable-float'. Shaders pair readTexture with the filtering u_sampler, so the format policy prefers rgba16float when the feature is missing.
sampleTypes.unfilterable-float: r32float without float32-filterable. Always unfilterable so the layout is identical on every device; sample depth with non_filtering_sampler (binding 5) or textureLoad, never u_sampler.

shaderUsageFlagsNote: loadShader/reloadShader usageBits: the bridge (src/wasm/bridge/wgslAnalysis.ts, also used by the TS renderer) sets a bit when a shader references that binding beyond its declaration, and C++ skips the matching per-frame copy when it is clear. Generated into src/wasm/bridge/_contracts.ts and wasm_renderer/wasm_contracts.h by npm run gen:wasm-contracts.
